newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: One, three and six-month Saudi t-bill rates fall.
newsitem.headline: One, three and six-month Saudi t-bill rates fall.

text.p: Yields dropped at this week's Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency offering of treasury bills worth three billion riyals, a banker said on Monday.

The yield on 28-day bills fell to 5.3332 percent from 5.4217 percent last week and the rate on 91-day paper declined to 5.5075 from 5.5869 percent. The yield on 182-day bills dropped to 5.6669 percent from 5.7733.
One-month interbank rates were put at 5-1/2, 3/8 percent, three months were at 5-5/8, 1/2 percent and six months were at 5-13/16, 11/16 percent.
